Source is web/browser-only (rule 4/7): react-i18next useTranslation, lucide-react SVG icons, and the @/lib/cn Tailwind merger have no native parity surface. Per rule 7 a native-safe implementation was built. useTranslation -> local useNativeTranslationFallback hook (matches BrowserCompatBanner/AiLimitBanner ports) that returns the inline English fallback AND interpolates {{token}} options via Object.entries(...).split().join(), so the threshold/noun/current values still render. i18n keys emptyState.threshold.defaultItem and emptyState.threshold.message and the exact English copy are preserved.

Behavior/state/prop parity preserved: prop names (currentCount, threshold, itemNoun, sectionLabel, description, message, action, className, testId) and the `noun`/`defaultMessage` locals are unchanged; the itemNoun ?? fallback and message ?? defaultMessage precedence are reproduced exactly; description renders only when truthy and the message paragraph always renders (defaultMessage when message is absent). description/message/action stay ReactNode -- a renderCopy() helper wraps raw string/number copy in the styled AppText the web

provided and passes through caller-supplied native nodes, so non-string nodes are not coerced.

DOM -> RN primitives: container
-> View; the two text

-> AppText (tone secondary/muted); the action

-> View; CheckCircle2 -> a '✓' AppText glyph inside an emerald ring (colors.success / colors.successBorder, h-5 w-5 -> 20px) and Info -> a muted 'ⓘ' circled-i glyph (h-3 w-3 -> 12px), both decorative via accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility=no-hide-descendants to mirror aria-hidden. No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or web UI components are imported.

Visual-intent mapping: Tailwind/CSS -> shared native tokens. text-emerald-400 -> colors.success (#34d399 exact); --text-primary/--text-secondary/--text-muted -> colors.textPrimary / AppText tone secondary / tone muted; --glass-border -> colors.border (rgba 255/255/255 .12); bg-[--surface-1]/40 -> backgroundColor rgba(12,18,31,0.4); rounded-2xl -> borderRadius 16, border -> 1px; text-sm/text-xs -> fontSize 14/12; gap-2/gap-3 -> spacing.sm/spacing.md; mt-0.5/mt-2/mt-3 -> 2 / spacing.sm / spacing.md; leading-relaxed -> lineHeight 18. The responsive sm:px-5/sm:py-6 step has no native breakpoint so it collapses to the base px-4 py-5 (paddingHorizontal spacing.md, paddingVertical spacing.lg).

cn/className: React Native has no className, so `className` is retained on props for source compatibility but ignored (destructured as _className) and a `style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>` override is added for native consumers (mirrors the SourceLayerBadge port). role=status + aria-live=polite -> accessibilityLiveRegion=polite on the container (not marked `accessible`, so an action button stays independently focusable). testId -> testID.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
